init_distributed_environment: initialize the distributed environment with world size, rank, backend, and timeout settings
initialize_model_parallel: initialize tensor, pipeline, data, expert, and decode context model parallel groups from config
build_group_coordinator: build a GroupCoordinator instance wrapping PyTorch ProcessGroups for CPU and device communication
destroy_model_parallel: destroy all initialized model parallel groups including tp, pp, dp, ep, dcp, pcp, and eplb
test_in_the_same_node_as: test whether ranks in a process group reside on the same node using shared memory checks
